name: Analisis Konfigurasi Fortinet Firewall Policy

inputs.content:
config firewall policy
  edit 1
    set name "AllowAll"
    set srcintf "any"
    set dstintf "any"
    set action accept
    set srcaddr "all"
    set dstaddr "all"
    set service "ALL"
  next
end

issues.description: Firewall policy menerima semua traffic dari dan ke semua interface

edge_cases: Policy dengan service terbatas tapi address any
